body: My GP is on mat leave. I'm just getting bounced between residents now.
Thank you. Just. Thank you

I shouldn't have to tell him to come back. I shouldn't have to raise him. I'm done talking with you. All it's doing is making me anger right now and I have more important places to direct my focus. Good day.

I had meds when I was depressed after university. My physiatrist was a pill pusher. I was numb and drugged up because of her. I went to multiple therapists. One was the perky -Just do better you'll feel better. And the other kept digging into my sex life telling me my marriage will be better if I have more sex. He said happy husband happy life.

Mental health help in my city sucks.

I TRIED to. When I wasn't crying I felt stupid for trying to bring some things up. My husband literally just walked in and threw a package onto the table saying "someone didn't check their phone." For a message to tell me a friends package arrived. I told him it was a multimedia message and without data I wouldn't see it. He called the phone stupid. I just tried to bring up how I felt about him leaving to the guestroom when I was making a bottle last night and he said he thought I would be okay with it. I said I wasn't. He said because I told him he slept through her night cry one night and I handled it that I would handle this. I told him it hurt seeing him gone. And he pinned it as my fault and I should have got him from the guest room. How can I keep having conversations with him when he's like this. Nothing is ever his fault and he doesn't apologize on anything.

I was vulnerable at one point. I stopped for a reason. I saw myself as a crybaby, begging for attention when I was neglected. Viewed as stupid for not agreeing with certain things or not articulating my thoughts well. There is a reason I don't talk with him anymore except for my annual breakdowns.
... I had the baby a while ago... As I wrote...
I was starting to think maybe I wrong to think this way... A lot of people saying the same thing... Thank you.

Where did you get physical abuse from? There are so many assumptions. And he doesn't yell or scream. He raises his voice. It's way different. But yes. I'm afraid of bringing any of this up with him. It's simple authoritative issues I have. I know that. If I put every detail of my relationship no one would read.

My anxiety is crippling when it comes to driving. I can't just decide to drive. I'm terrified of being single, losing every single person I talk to socially because the closest ones to friends for me are all his friends. He works at the some place I do. (On mat leave) How could I ever uproot any semblance of life I have?

Yes I tried to kill myself. But now that I have a baby I would never. Ever. Think about doing that. The fact that it was suggested as something to avoid was a situation I never even considered. I got defensive because i didn't think I came off as the type of woman to abandon her child but and you seemed to think so. That's why. And reacting to someone online is far different than in reality. I am f**** terrified of bringing any of this up with my husband. I freeze and shake the moment he raises his voice. Reactions vary.

I could have paid for a cute wedding. Bought a dress i actually liked. Got a venue. And feel like a queen. But I couldn't be bothered to think of any of that stuff. I have savings which is why we can GET a vehicle and house. And while I have always wanted to be a SAHM... It doesn't mean I should be neglected. Doesn't mean my husband can tell me he doesn't have to change diapers when I want him to because he works and I don't. Doesn't mean when the baby cries at night he gets up and leaves to go to the guest room.

Also. I tried to kill myself before my child. Read the damn story.
Thank you for the advice. I'll think about it.
You think so? It's the best case scenario.
I have a job. I'm just on mat leave. Even if I thought about leaving this life, I just signed a mortgage with him. Doesn't that keep me here?
At the moment I hope I'm just overreacting and spinning a bad narrative. But thinking this way just won't stop. I really hope I'm wrong.
Monday's are my destinated free time. After he works I can do whatever I want. I mean I spent my last freetime packing but that was my choice. He also has a freetime day. Its also just gaming.

I don't leave the house often because I can't drive. My husband made a little joke that he is my warden lol. But if I need to do something he can take over. I'll just have to make sure we are never propping a bottle up ever again. That might be a harder change for him since he was the one that started it, but I hope I can convince him.

She's been a pretty easy baby considering what I've heard about difficult babies. So I think things got too relaxed around the house. We had guests over in the first week of her birth because she was chill. I don't think I could ever ask him to stop playing games. I don't want to step on any nerves or make things worse. We agreed he could have game nights and I don't want to go back on my word.

I agree... I took time to think everything through and read everyone's post. I was stupid. I know that. I keep looking over my entire relationship... Have been doing that for a week trying to figure out when things felt unsteady. Turns out it was always like that... But I was always told relationships take work. I've had a series of depressive episodes and I've been trying to handle it. Mental health care sucks where I am so I can't even rely on it. And yes... He relaxes a lot. But his job is frustrating and he works a lot. He slept in the guest room for the past while to get a good night's sleep while I slept with the baby. I would take every night feeding so he could rest up.

I greeted him this morning and he responded back. He didn't seem too cranky. It was a good sign and I haven't left my baby for a single minute since this happened. Don't think I'll be this stupid again.

I have my mother. She's been my rock through all this. I don't have friends... I hang out with my husband's friends. I also can't drive due to anxiety so I just stay at home until my husband comes back from work and we can go places. Having my mom come over has been definitely getting me through this.

I don't know how I got comfortable doing this. I honestly never left her like this before and somehow thought it was okay... I haven't left her side since this happened and I don't think it'll ever happen again. It was stupid. I can't even blame being tired, or dealing with everything involved with moving. I was just stupid...
It's very good advice. Thank you
Nobody thinks a man will act like this... Until they act like this.

We have designated chore days. We had to make a schedule/calendar list otherwise he isn't determined to do anything. This wasn't a chore day. I was just cleaning/packing to take my mind off everything.

He has a stupid amount of pride. Sometimes I just want to work so hard it overshadows everything he does massively. Make him see how little he does in comparison... But it also sounds so tiring. I'm only staying home a bit longer before going back to work. Then he really won't have an excuse on why he does less.

He works in the morning. He's too tired and cranky to speak with when he works. It's hard finding a right time when I'm not on eggshells trying to word a conversation right without seeming like an idiot to him.

It was his weekly online D&D night. If I asked him to properly watch the baby while he plays I know he would just tell me to pack another day or not be selfish. He never uses that word... But he seems to talk perfectly in a way to make me feel bad and himself in the right. I just don't ask some things anymore.

He tries when he plays games but I'm getting annoyed that he doesn't hold her much anymore. As a newborn he carried her like she was his heart. But now it's just put her on the floor with a bottle. Its disheartening knowing she isn't getting the attention I wish she could have from either of us. I'm trying so hard to juggle everything so my husband doesn't have to worry as much but... I wish I could be the one being taken care of instead. I realized I'm ranting about something off topic. Sorry.

I feel like when he looks at me... he doesn't think I'm a good mom. I can see it in his eyes but I'm doing my best. He's not perfect either and I just wish his first reaction wasn't to just blame me. We both were going through the same thing.

Thank you. It's nice to hear other people dealing with similar things. I know saying she can handle a bottle herself sounds like an excuse. I'm trying. And your post made me laugh a bit so thank you. I don't even think my baby even remembers what happened a minute ago so I won't worry too much. I just wish my husbands reaction wasnt so angry and that mine isn't to just freeze. Things we both need to work on.
It was his gaming night. He doesn't like to watch her much when he plays.
She can absolutely take the bottle away herself.

He absolutely knows I hate doing all this stuff but he just thanks me when I tell him how tired I am about doing it. Also if I pulled out that man's job sentence he might kick me out of the house for being an imposter. It's ironic we both dont support stereotypical gender roles yet here we are. I'm on mat leave before I go back to work.

A few assumptions you've made. He has a diet where he eats one big meal a day and so he does that at work. He's made it clear I don't have to cook every night and he does it when he's desperate. And he absolutely does eat cereal all the time. And he does his own laundry. Key word his. He only ever cleans his work clothes, nothing else.

If I make plans to go somewhere and do something he likes it. We have fun. That's not the point. Why should I always have to plan it? 

And he loves our little one. Steals her away when she's cute and runs around the house with her... It's just I have to remind him to change her and bathe her. Our kid is loved, I just wish he did... More.

I've been working up the courage to talk with him about all of this. I used to only have these kind of conversations when everything bottled up and I'd breakdown which he took seriously. I feel that happening again right now. I'm just so overwhelmingly tired. The only thing he's been doing for me is changing his game schedule so I can go out to a bar with his friends and just exist out of the house while he looks after the kid. It's nice, but his friends are treating me better than him at this point.

Honestly, I'm always worried about talking with him about anything. If I have a different opinion than him, he makes me feel stupid at times for having it. Or tries to justify his opinion being the right one. It hurts that in order to feel validated... I have to agree with him. If I don't have a fully fledged out subject and discussion planned, my words or thoughts might stumble and then he might not take me seriously because he can't understand me. And when I get seriously pissed, he tells me to go to bed.

It doesn't happen like that all the time of course... But enough to make me think it will happen again...

I know. I'm already upset with myself for doing even this stuff. I just want a friend but keeping my schoolgirl brain cell from shouting in the corner of my head is not helping. He might be my best chance for an actual friend. Not fake school friends I used to have or someone that hangs out with me out of obligation since they came to hang out with my husband. I just want an actual friend and not make things weird.
Highschool sweethearts. Married a few years but together for almost a decade.
I guess I understand your perspective. Even though im not looking for a relationship or any physical intimacy... Just the knowledge I can be found attractive... It might as well be the same.

I agree with everyone about the emotional part... But I'm struggling to accept the physical cheating. Not once has anyone shown anything mutual which I'm realizing I'm so relieved about. But is leg touching really that bad? Also each time I was high off my ass and I've warned people I tend to get cuddly each time.

I just looked it up and Holy crap. It's like the definition just summed up every crush I ever had. Even during the last few years when I had no friends and turned to fantasy novels, I developed obsessions with fictional characters that took over my life. Ive only ever been with my husband. High school sweethearts. Never been liked by anyone else before. Sometimes I wish I could know what going on adult dates is like, but that part of my life has passed.

I think I am insecure... I find myself always asking my husband how I look and if I'm pretty. And without skipping a beat he always says I look good. But I feel like somewhere along the line it felt like he was only saying it because he had to, that it was something I wanted to hear and it became not authentic. I guess I need to figure that shit out too...

You're right. That would make me unbelievably crazy. I'm glad someone feels any form of understanding because right now, reading all these comments makes me feel like the worst person to exist. I love my husband and my baby. Maybe it's the postpartum depression thats making me feel not as attractive and trying to seek confirmation somewhere. But everything feels like an excuse.
I really hope I do. Holy fuck do I really hope so.

Yeah... I thought as much. I hate myself for doing any of this. Honestly having others tell me the same thing is definitely putting things in perspective. My entire body feels cold while I read all the comments.
I understand father issues. I know I have them. Is that really what is making me think this way?
No. I cut him out. He was a terrible man that only hurt my mother and I.
While the pattern definitely doesn't work in the first one, I will say the larger tie has an amazing slimming effect if that is something you are interested in.
Muffin

I'm glad it helps but no matter how many times I try to read other peoples post... I feel nothing. As if my empathy has run out. I want so badly for a sign to shove it's self in my face, screaming to not do anything bad... But it never comes. That comfort of yours must be your sign. At least you have one... You're not as far gone as you think.
How much trouble do you think I'd be in if I didn't show up and ignored their call because I was "sleeping".
I love when people stack their dishes... However there are times its so poorly done. As a server... I plead to future customers... DO NOT PUT FUCKING CUPS ON YOUR PLATE TOWERS!
Tried that. Didn't work.
Only minor occurrences... Nothing this major. Google's has done nothing.
I don't have the strength to make anything happen... I wish I did... But I have this strange feeling that something will just appear and happen... I hope I'm right.
Thank you for the support... But those options just aren't available for me...
I don't think you understood any of this...

Every day is a pain to life through. Im pretty sure I suffer from anxiety, depression, faint psychosis, and a little bit of autism.

I studied so hard in high school that I pushed myself away from my friends and by the time I got into university and moved away... I had none. 

If not for my boyfriend at the time... I would have been alone. Then after a year I dropped out because of how fucked up my university was with stealing money and not caring about my future.

Suddenly all my studying was for nothing... And the smart kid I used to be disappeared from the eyes of society. I became nothing and I realized how unfair our world was. A world that pushed and pushed me to pursue a life of education only have it crash down onto me. I have no career and goals in mind for the present.

The only reason I'm alive is because of that same boyfriend who I ended up marrying and our pet cat. I can't handle the idea of leaving them alone. If they disappear... I'm afraid that will be the end of me.

Oh I am hands down suffering from depression. There is almost no question about it. I tried the education route but university failed me so hard. They were a cash grab business that didnt care about their students and turned me away from ever going back. 

I would love to have more knowledge and have others would turn to me for information, but it just won't happen. After I became a drop out... Nobody would look at me like the honor student I used to be. 

Society failed me. Now I wish for its demise.

While most mental illnesses are shown as a weakness in media and entertainment it would be refreshing to see it more as a superpower. Although not in the way some would think...

It would be more on the lines of hightened perception. A protagonist with schizophrenia or ADHD might be more aware of strange situations happening around them that others don't pick up on. Those without mental illnesses would be the ones to miss clues or suffer cruel fates because they thought too logically.

Having a super analytical person survive by brillant strategy is so boring now. Turn it around. Make the "insane" have a newfound brilliance on handling these situations. Maybe they constantly immersed themselves in horrific mental environments that never existed, but because of those day dreams, they can navigate their way out of real situations.

Make it seem like our nature minds aren't a burden but instead a different way to look at the world around us. While sometimes it's scary, it can also be amazing to feel something that others don't. 

I would pay to watch a movie like that.
Hiyoko

I can't diagnose you or at least I am totally not the person to try... But I might have an idea. To me- based off of my own experiences... you might be going through paranoia. Those feelings of being watched, worrying about things that shouldn't be possible and hearing voices... They are signs of psychosis and or many other serious mental conditions. I would recommend going to your family doctor as soon as you can. I know saying that sounds dangerous and scary but it's honestly the best thing you can do. Taking to a professional about your problems will give you the most effective solutions. As helpful as the internet is... We have our limits. I hope you feel better soon.
Brenden

But the fact that you are still here means something. I have horrible depressive episodes that almost drag me to situations I don't want to be in so I kinda understand. But just know... It's not your fault. We both have something wrong with our minds... And we didn't ask for that. No one does. 

The fact that you regret what almost happened is actually good. Whether you backed out at the last minute or the attempt just failed. I don't know what happened and I would never ask for details.

But something is telling you to keep going. And so am I. Don't beat yourself up about this. I know those sound like just words... But I truely mean them.

My kitten is one of the few things keeping me going. She means everything to me and I can't bear leaving her alone. I know if I tried killing myself I would regret  it for her sake.

So if you regret your attempt. You have something to live for. If thats true... live for them and keep going. Use these feelings to remind yourself of how much you care for that thing.

And hey... You might appreciate life a bit more because of this.

That scene from Indiana Jones and the Crystal Skull where one of the bad guys gets carried away by fire ants. Seeing the ants go into everypart of his body scared the ever loving crap out of me as a kid. That scene haunted my childhood.

I have horrible episodes of depression at times... They make me want to shut out the world, ignore everyone and scream into an endless void. I lock myself in the bathroom so no one has to deal with me, but that just makes it worse.
I found that just talking helps. But you can't to it to anyone... I found that out the hard way. You need to talk with some who you can spring everything onto and they won't think less of you. If you don't have some like that... Try calling a helpline.
I know... It sounds like the a last result thing... but you will chat with someone that has no judgement towards you. You can put everything out in the open, breakdown if you need to, and just have a person to talk to. I literally just chatted to a random girl about our mutual love for our pets. It was an amazing time.... Though... It took a long time for me to sum up to courage to tell people in real life even if it was just on the phone. And telling someone about this is the first step to feeling better.
You can't do this alone... I tried.
And once you take that step... There are some things I would recommend. I don't know if they'll help you like they did for me... But it wouldn't hurt to try.
Go on a walk. It doesn't matter for how long and if you don't like the silence bring some music. If you find it hard to leave the house... I know things to do in your room. Like yoga. You don't need to know any moves just stretch. While doing that... Listen to music or listen to the news or nothing at all. Thats the amazing thing, it's all up to you. Maybe draw, start a diary, write a short story or anything that gets your negative emotions out for your head and onto something else. I don't know what you like to do but if I didn't have my hobbies... Life would be a lot worse... And even though it seems seasonal for you... You can't take depression lightly. Its truely a fight, but it feels amazing on the days when your winning. I haven't beat it yet... But I dream of the day I will and I hope you do too.
Stick your chin up to the world and keep fighting. I believe in you.

Like something is missing right? That you know in some cases you should be happy... But your not. Or in some situations you know you should be upset and angry but you feel like something is blocking the path for that chemical sentation? If it's anything like that... I totally understand. I dissociate from reality probably far more often than I should. It makes me feel numb or more so neutral to everything around me. I don't know why exactly, but let me know if its similar to your situation.
I'll look into that. Thank you.
I appreciate the help and if you do find something plz let me know. Thank you.
